'''Trivyakna Korl''' was an individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Korl oversaw operations at the [[Nessem Shipyards]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located near to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nessem]], and each morning, Korl reviewed a list of all newly-arrived individuals on the station that were carrying weapons.
